summary: Enhance your skills with our Agricultural Market Information Systems Training Course. Learn to analyze data and make informed decisions in agriculture.
lede: Agricultural market information systems organize the collection, validation, analysis, and reporting of market data. This course is for professionals who collect, analyze, coordinate, or communicate agricultural market information and need practical workflows that account for limited field coverage or uneven connectivity. Participants practice designing price collection templates, applying data-quality checks, interpreting price trends, and preparing market bulletins and stakeholder reports.
audienceIntro: This agricultural market information systems training is designed for professionals who collect, verify, analyze, or communicate market data and need more reliable AMIS workflows.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic working knowledge of agricultural markets, routine reporting, and spreadsheets such as Microsoft Excel. No programming is required, although experience with mobile data collection tools, market price surveys, or monitoring and evaluation workflows will help you move faster. The course is suitable for foundation to intermediate learners who want practical AMIS capability rather than advanced statistical modelling. A laptop is recommended for exercises and template work.
